displayDescription: A pulse leaves the IDEA pad, branches at junction J1 and lights U1, U2 and U3 in order of trace length.
motionEngine: GSAP 3.15.1 (local gsap.min.js, single paused timeline at window.__timelines.video)
audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, effects or narration.
limitations: Illustrative procedural PCB: flat top-view SVG solder mask, copper and plating; no physical copper lighting, conductivity or real signal timing is simulated.
Current is shown as a constant-speed brightness state (560 px/s along each copper centreline); branch arrival delays are derived from route length, not measured electrical data.
STYLE.json supplies no tech.preview_recipes and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json exists, so the preview demonstrates the core characteristic action rather than a named recipe.
Stable top view without a moving crop: the background and via grid must stay stationary, so focus follows the active trace through its brightness instead of a camera move.
Blender was not used, per user instruction.
